# ChatGPT Always-On Instructions for Gilded Rose Kata

## Goal
Refactor the Gilded Rose codebase to improve maintainability and extensibility.

## Rules
- Do NOT change existing behavior.
- Ensure all existing tests pass.
- Use the Strategy Pattern for different item types.
- Each item type should have its own class.
- Avoid large if-else chains.
- Keep code clean, readable, and modular.

## Testing
- Generated code must pass all unit tests.
- Do not break existing functionality.

## Behavior Constraints
- Quality is never negative.
- Quality never exceeds 50 (except Sulfuras).
- Sulfuras never changes.
